result.title: Supervising Sound Localization by In-the-wild Egomotion
result.comment: CVPR 2025 Highlight (IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition)
result.summary: We present a method for learning binaural sound localization using egomotion as a supervisory signal. Over the course of a video, the cameras direction to a sound source will change as the camera moves. We train an audio model to predict sound directions that are consistent with visual estimates of camera motion, which we obtain using traditional methods from multi-view geometry. This provides a weak but plentiful form of supervision that we combine with traditional binaural cues. To evaluate this method, we propose a dataset of real-world audio-visual videos with egomotion. We show that our model can successfully learn from real-world data and that it performs well on sound localization tasks

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出以相机自运动（egomotion）作为弱监督信号，训练双耳声音定位模型，使其预测的声音方向与多视角几何估计的相机运动保持一致，并构建了真实世界音视频数据集进行评估。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 主线的联系较间接，但其「用可估计的运动变化作为弱监督来校准另一模态的方向预测」的思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中跨模态证据筛选与弱监督下的状态更新问题。
